Name: Pudens
Summary: Pudens was one of the believers with Paul in Rome who sends greetings in 2 Timothy, alongside Eubulus, Linus, and Claudia.
KeyStory: Pudens was one of the believers with Paul in Rome who sends greetings in 2 Timothy, alongside Eubulus, Linus, and Claudia.
LifeLesson: A name in a final greeting marks presence at the hardest hour.
